**Subject:** Time to connect on recent work and support

Hi Alex,

I’ve put a 1:1 on your calendar for **[day] at [time]** to talk about how things are going and how I can better support you. I want to be upfront that this will be a performance-focused conversation so it doesn’t feel like it’s coming out of nowhere.

Over the past quarter, I’ve noticed some specific issues:

- The **Persona V3 integration** shipped on **March 28**, 13 days after the **March 15** target.  
- The **evaluation pipeline** that was due **April 1** is still not complete.  
- Several teammates have raised concerns that your **code reviews** have become very brief (often a one-line “LGTM”) even on complex PRs.  
- You missed **two team standups** without notice and were unresponsive on Teams for more than three hours on multiple occasions.

This is a change from last year, when you led the **Persona V2 launch**, mentored two junior engineers, and earned an **“Exceeds”** rating. That track record is why I want to address this quickly and constructively.

In our meeting, I’d like to:
- Understand what’s behind these recent gaps (including anything outside work you’re comfortable sharing)  
- Reconfirm expectations around deadlines, code reviews, and communication  
- Align on a concrete plan and support you need to get back to your usual level of impact

If the time I proposed doesn’t work, please suggest an alternative within the next few days.

Thanks,  
[Your Name]
